locator.precision: Planar centroid of Pulaski Area GIS parcel 44L-075.02-001.00 (ONE SOURCE ADDN Lot 1A; 2.757 geodesic acres, about 124 by 189 m), the only parcel with situs 15707 Chenal Pkwy, Little Rock, owned by TierPoint Properties LLC. locator.identity_review: TierPoint's page gives 'Little Rock (LIT) 15707 Chenal Parkway, Little Rock, AR 72211'. The PAGIS address query returns exactly one parcel for number 15707 on Chenal, with situs '15707 CHENAL PKWY', ZIP 72211, a commercial parcel type and owner TIERPOINT PROPERTIES LLC (assessment-record date 19 October 2026), so address and ownership both tie the parcel to the operator. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or business-park centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The parcel service publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid represents the whole tax parcel, and the position of the data-centre space within the building is not published.

locator.identity_review: TierPoint gives 322 E. Archer Street, Tulsa 74120. No Tulsa County parcel in ZIP 74120 carries 322 E Archer; parcel 00500920131140 at 318 E Archer St N is the only one whose business-name field reads 'TIERPOINT DATA', and its 36,360 sq ft of improvements match TierPoint's '36,000+ total square feet' (TierPoint's 2017 release gives 37,000 sq ft for its Brady district facility). The neighbouring parcels at 301, 305 and 310 E Archer are offices, lofts and a hotel of other businesses. The 318/322 numbering difference is unresolved and is disclosed; the parcel is selected on the business name and floor area. No geocoder or city centre is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The parcel service publishes no positional accuracy; the centroid represents the whole tax parcel, and the position of the data-centre space within the building is not published.
